purpose: Read-only Runway production-contract audit; no generation, upload, key read, billing action or account switch.

repository.target: Local dealer production planning; existing Runway developer API.
canonicalFacts: DRIFT records wan3 through the developer API for V6 and P7/P6/pink samples.
DRIFT records RUNWAY_API_KEY in ignored .env.local; the key was not read during this audit.
DRIFT distinguishes the historical two 12-second P4 jobs from V6 six-second center jobs; historical P4 prompts did not explicitly require a flip or hand transfer.
limitations: Existing clips and generation receipts were not inspected by this subtask; no motion or visual acceptance is asserted.
Developer-API organization, balance and model entitlement were not queried.

skillCall.reason: The offered mood-board, resize-image, social-thumbnail and workflow-builder skills do not match this contract audit.

mcp.identityBoundary: This connector workspace and balance do not establish the identity or balance behind dealer's developer-API key.

generateVideoContract.source: mcp__codex_apps__runway_generate_video description and input schema, observed 2026-11-10

wan3.referenceVideo: { url, durationSeconds }; source at most 15 seconds
exclusions: startFrame/endFrame cannot be combined with reference images or reference video

generateVideoContract.motionControlAvailabilityBoundary: whoami lists kling-3-motion-control, but this generate_video schema has no corresponding model enum or dedicated motion-control input. No execution path was verified.

editVideoContract.source: mcp__codex_apps__runway_edit_video description and input schema, observed 2026-11-10
editVideoContract.workflow: Choose source frame, preview edited frame, then submit approved video edit.
editVideoContract.prompt: Short targeted transformation; extraMotionPrompt only for motion absent from source/keyframe.
editVideoContract.intendedUse: Preserve original motion/framing/timing while changing an appearance detail.
editVideoContract.warning: Preservation is a documented design goal, not verified pixel-perfect output or a promise to repair incorrect source choreography.

developerApi.acquisition: Public unauthenticated GET; exact variants parsed for wan3 and aleph2.

headers.Authorization: Bearer credential, not read or recorded

wan3ImageToVideo.promptImage: Image URI, or array: first/last position for anchors; omit position for reference images. Modes cannot be mixed.
wan3ImageToVideo.framing: Keyframe output follows the first frame.
wan3ImageToVideo.boundary: Official input guide and MCP explicitly disallow combining first/last anchors with references.

exampleOnlyNotSubmitted.promptText: <one concrete card action matching the verified source motion>

referenceVideos.uri: <registered clip showing one correct physical flip>

wan3MotionReference.controlLimit: Reference video supplies context; schema offers no motion-strength, per-frame constraints, negative-prompt or timestamp-schedule field.
wan3MotionReference.routeBoundary: wan3 is present in text_to_video and image_to_video but absent from the current video_to_video model variants. Do not send a WAN3 developer request to /v1/video_to_video merely because MCP calls the mode video-to-video.
wan3MotionReference.mediaFormatBoundary: WAN3 schema does not expose outputFormat or output fps. Inspect the actual successful artifact rather than claiming container/fps from this schema.

keyframes.required: uri plus either seconds or at

optionalRange.rules: Whole-second edit window; keyframe must fall within it; all keyframes use ranges or none do.

exampleOnlyNotSubmitted.promptText: Change the exposed card face to solid pink.

aleph2VideoEdit.exampleBoundary: seconds:3 is illustrative; choose an actual source timestamp showing the exposed card face before submission.
aleph2VideoEdit.suitability: Use when choreography is already correct and only card appearance needs changing. Do not expect it to eliminate a double flip while retaining all original motion.

comparison.advantage: No new generation cost; retains the inspected source movement.
comparison.condition: Only if frame-by-frame review confirms required source hand, one flip, visible face and target P7 placement.
comparison.limitation: Existing historical duration/prompt alone proves none of these conditions.

comparison.advantage: Half the per-attempt output cost of 12 seconds at the same resolution.
comparison.limitation: Repeated reported double-flip/back-back failures remain unresolved; anchors constrain ends, not full finger/card mechanics.

comparison.advantage: More time for a slower action and final hold.
comparison.limitation: Inference: it changes pacing but not the control method. No evidence found that duration or timestamp prose fixes the reported repeated error.
comparison.recommendation: Do not spend another attempt solely on longer text and duration.

comparison.option: WAN3 with verified motion reference and identity image, without anchors
comparison.advantage: Retains current provider/model while supplying the missing movement example.
comparison.limitation: Contextual guidance, not deterministic motion transfer; needs a genuinely correct source clip.
comparison.recommendation: Preferred next controlled experiment after source acceptance.

comparison.advantage: More appropriate for card-face color/appearance replacement.
comparison.limitation: Model changes and more expensive; unsuitable as the first fix when source has a double flip.
comparison.recommendation: Use only for a specific appearance repair after physical motion acceptance.

developerPricing.note: Calculated from published base rates, not an executed quote. No balance inference across API and connector.

prompting.recommendation: Describe one visible physical sequence using positive, concrete motion language; fixed camera; source hand from dealer perspective and destination stated separately.
prompting.scope: General Runway guidance, with Gen-4-specific guidance identified separately; no WAN3-specific prompt recipe claiming guaranteed card mechanics was found.
prompting.repeatedFailureResponse: Change conditioning information instead of adding increasingly elaborate prohibitions.
acceptanceCriteria: Exactly one continuous physical rotation of the same card.
Required hand remains the source hand through the specified action.
Card edge and face remain physically continuous; no back-back substitution.
Correct final visible face and P7 location.
No extra card, hand transfer, second flip or final reset hidden between accepted frames.

alternativeMotionControl.capability: Character image plus performance video transfers body movement, hand gestures and expression.
alternativeMotionControl.constraints: Single visible person, continuous shot, stable moderate motion. Image orientation maximum 10 seconds; video orientation maximum 30 seconds; 720p or 1080p.
alternativeMotionControl.limitation: Guide does not guarantee exact small-object/card mechanics. Listed in connector whoami, but a callable MCP/developer path was not established here.
alternativeMotionControl.recommendation: A documented specialist fallback to investigate only if WAN3 reference conditioning fails; no provider/model switch performed.

sources.use: Exact WAN3 reference and Aleph2 request schema.
WAN3 durations/resolutions, anchor-reference exclusion and media limits.
Explicit physical motion and positive concise language; Gen-4-specific guidance.
Targeted edit and preservation intent; extra-motion distinction.
Specialist motion-reference alternative and input limits.

alternateModelFollowup.request: One alternative-model comparison using the same historical P4.C1 anchors/prompt and four-second duration; white-card anchors remain a separate experiment.

latestFailure.source: Parent task report, not independently viewed in this subtask.
latestFailure.report: WAN3 four-second image-to-video changed yellow to blue between frames 63 and 64 without a physical card edge.

recommendation.reason: Different model family, supports both anchors and audio:false, preserves first-frame aspect ratio with paired anchors, and has a lower published trial cost than the other compared 1080p alternatives.
recommendation.evidenceBoundary: This is the best controlled comparison among the checked contracts, not a proven best model for card physics. No source or benchmark found establishes reliable wrist rotation, card rigidity or absence of color morphing for this exact scene.
recommendation.method: Retain exact original first/last bytes and prompt for the first comparison; change model only where its API requires different framing controls. Keep default cfgScale=0.5.
recommendation.risk: Quality/success probability is unknown and unquantified. Morphing, wrong hand, extra turns and geometry errors remain possible despite a more suitable comparison.
recommendation.stopRule: Inspect the full motion, especially the edge-on crossing, after this one result; do not infer success from endpoint colors or launch an automatic retry sequence.

developerApiContract.authentication: Existing dealer developer-API credential; no account switch or key read performed by this audit.

requestExampleNotSubmitted.promptText: <exact existing P4.C1 prompt, provided it is at most 2500 characters>

framing.reason: Paired anchors follow first-frame aspect ratio. This model's ratio enum is only 1920:1080, 1080:1920, 1440:1440; neither auto_1080p nor 1764:1174 is valid.
framing.outputDimensions: Exact returned dimensions require artifact inspection; 1764x1174 output is not promised.
framing.auto1080TransferWarning: Do not carry WAN3's auto_1080p parameter into Kling.

comparedModels.choice: Not selected: documented speed variant, no evidence it fixes WAN3's observed physical failure.
Not selected for this one comparison: more expensive and its explicit ratio enum has no auto_1080p or exact 1764:1174.
Not selected: native audio has no disable toggle; cannot satisfy the stated audio:false contract.

whiteVariant.note: Needs separately prepared and reviewed anchor images. Do not silently whiten either historical reference or mix anchor changes into the first model-only comparison.

alternateModelFollowup.availabilityBoundary: Official developer API supports kling3.0_pro; actual entitlement or task acceptance for dealer's key was not checked. Earlier connector whoami lists kling-3-pro but cannot prove developer-account entitlement.

sources.use: Parsed exact image_to_video variants, prompt limits, paired-anchor framing, optional ratio and duration/audio controls.
No-audio Kling3 Pro rate, WAN3 Prime and Seedance2 1080p rates; Kling4 has no audio toggle.

outcome.recommendation: Reuse an accepted original if available; otherwise use a correct motion reference with WAN3 before considering a different model. No further blind six/twelve-second text-only retry is supported by this audit.
